name: Doll
source:
The story takes place when Doll wakes up alone and lost in a forest. A disembodied voice advises Doll that he must escape the forest or be forever lost to the dangers that lurk within the darkness. Doll soon discovers that not all is what it seems in the forest.

[Edited from [url=https://cervineprince.itch.io/doll-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在娃娃独自醒来并迷失在森林中时。一个无形的声音建议多尔必须逃离森林，否则就会永远迷失在潜伏在黑暗中的危险之中。多尔很快发现森林里的一切并不像看上去的那样。

[编辑自[url=https://cervineprince.itch.io/doll-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
